methods.label: Cancel the shared expression
methods.explanation:
Combining the reciprocals reveals the same expression in the numerator and denominator. Since \(a,b>0\), all original denominators are nonzero, and \(ab+1>0\). Therefore
\[
\frac{a+b^{-1}}{a^{-1}+b}
=\frac{(ab+1)/b}{(ab+1)/a}
=\frac ab.
\]
The given equation is consequently equivalent to \(a=13b\). The bound on the sum becomes
\[a+b=14b\le100.\]
Because \(14\cdot7=98\) and \(14\cdot8=112\), the possible positive integers are exactly \(b=1,2,\ldots,7\).

Each such \(b\) gives one distinct pair \((13b,b)\), and every valid pair must have this form. Hence there are \(\boxed{7}\) pairs, choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
